violations.affected_code:
IconButton(
      icon: Icon(isFavorite ? Icons.favorite : Icons.favorite_border),
      onPressed: onPressed,
    )
violations.explanation: The IconButton has no tooltip and the Icon has no semanticLabel, so screen readers (TalkBack/VoiceOver) will announce only 'button' without describing its purpose (e.g., 'Add to favorites').

violations.type: State not conveyed to assistive technologies
violations.explanation: The favorite/not-favorite state is communicated only visually by switching between a filled and outlined icon. No semantic toggled/selected state (e.g., Semantics(toggled: isFavorite) or isSelected) or state-dependent label is provided, so screen reader users cannot determine whether the item is currently favorited.
